info.description:
What the back office calls, through api-gateway-service's admin profile. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from the admin login; staff on several brands (and SUPER_ADMIN, always) name the brand they work on in `X-Act-As-Brand`.

Amounts are JSON numbers in the currency's units (940.5 is KES 940.50), with at most 4 decimals and no exponent; a numeric string ("940.5") is accepted too. Errors from identity are `{"error": "..."}`; from wallet and casino, `{"code": "...", "number": 0, "message": "..."}`.
